content: templetwo.com registered via Hostinger, DNS pointed to Cloudflare (bart.ns.cloudflare.com, michelle.ns.cloudflare.com). Propagation confirmed.
stack.templetwo.com routes to tunnel 9880c855-27dd-4e25-9bd4-e72438bdcb0b via Cloudflare CNAME. Permanent SSE endpoint: https://stack.templetwo.com/sse

cloudflared login requires cert.pem in ~/.cloudflared/. Without it, tunnel route dns commands fail. cert.pem is obtained by running cloudflared login and selecting domain in browser. DNS must be propagated to Cloudflare nameservers FIRST or domain wont appear.
templetwo.com registered (Hostinger), DNS on Cloudflare, stack.templetwo.com is permanent SSE endpoint. Quick tunnel (trycloudflare.com) used as bridge while DNS propagated.
